newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Rodman hairdo anathema in Philippine school.
newsitem.headline: Rodman hairdo anathema in Philippine school.

text.p: Chicago Bulls "bad boy" Dennis Rodman may have legions of fans around the world, but the basketball star's hairstyle is taboo in at least one Philippine school.

Concerned with "good grooming," officials of Wesleyan high school in northern Cabanatuan city are prohibiting their 970 students from colouring their hair in the style of the fiery U.S. National Basketball Association (NBA) player, principal Juanita Corpuz said on Monday.
Teachers and parents agreed to impose the guideline after several students had their hair tinted various colours, such as blue and yellow, Corpuz said by telephone.
Rodman is known for his off-beat ways and constantly changing hair colours. His father, a former U.S. serviceman named Philander, lives in the Philippines.
"Maybe he (Rodman) is an idol to them...but we want to inculcate proper values among our students," Corpuz said.
